Name: Entomologist Spider Mount
Author: PumpedFail
Description:
[i]Also see my total conversion [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55520]mod [/url]replacing all the coop and barn animals with insects![/i]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55316/55316-1794271128-655828656.png[/img] [b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8]Replaces in-game horse with a spider mount, complete with animations and the ability to wear hats! Choose between a tarantula, a black widow, or a blue mine spider! Includes changes to book, whistle, menus, and dialogue for immersion. Options to choose between saddled or bareback, and can add a spiderweb effect to the stables.[/color]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55316/55316-1794271128-655828656.png[/img] [b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Unzip "Entomologist Spider Mount.zip" into the Stardew Valley/Mods directory.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Configure options using the mod config menu on the main menu or in the config menu in-game.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Enjoy![/color]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55316/55316-1794271128-655828656.png[/img] [b][size=4]Main features[/size][/b]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Replaces horse sprite with one of three spider options (tarantula, black widow, or blue mine spider)[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Choose between saddled or bareback for each spider.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Add optional webbing overlay to stables, compatible with recolor.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Includes changes to horse book and horse whistle (species-dependent texture swap)[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- Includes several changes to dialogue options, menu titles, and item descriptions to keep consistent spider references throughout.[/color]

[size=4][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55316/55316-1794271128-655828656.png[/img] Requirements[/b][/size]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]

[b][size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55316/55316-1794271128-655828656.png[/img] A note on donations[/size][/b]
[size=3]If you like the mod, I would love to accept your donations. All donations (along with any revenue generated through the Donation Points program) will be donated to [url=https://www.stjude.org/donate/donate-to-st-jude.html]St. Jude Children's Hospital[/url] ... or you can just donate yourself and give me an updoot![/size]

Manifest.Description: Replaces the Stardew Valley horse with an animated 8-legged spider mount (with selectable species, toggleable saddle, carrot-feeding animations, hat support, and a mod-friendly webbed Stable overlay).
